title: What are Foundation Models Cooking in the Post-Soviet World?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on text-only and visual Question Answering (QA/VQA) tasks to predict the correct country of origin for traditional Post-Soviet food dishes, as well as assessing the accuracy of generated visual dish descriptions.

Comparing model predictions when prompted in Russian versus Ukrainian to demonstrate how the prompt language skews the predicted country of origin toward the language's dominant nation, and analyzing the impact of Russian-Ukrainian code-mixing (surzhyk) in pretraining data.
Measuring the systematic over-prediction of dominant nations (Russia and Ukraine) and the corresponding under-representation of minority Post-Soviet countries in dish origin attribution tasks.
